verdict.rationale: Mastra's tools documentation directly states that agents can load tools from remote MCP servers, so the product itself offers MCP-client tool consumption. The evidence is a single sentence, so the depth of support is unproven. The MCP docs server and MCP server-authoring evidence describe the server role and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented client configuration (connecting, transports, auth), local/stdio MCP server support, how discovered tools are exposed to agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can also load tools from remote MCP servers to expand an agent's capabilities.
